source_text: Moreover, in immigrant communities, parental circumcision choices foster cultural cohesion and identity preservation against assimilation pressures; for Muslim families in Western contexts like Sweden and the UK, forgoing the rite risks familial stigmatization and erosion of rites-of-passage traditions tied to masculinity and group belonging. [72] [73]
